therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Antifolate inhibition of thymidylate synthase and DNA crosslinking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation inhibition through DNA synthesis disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with recurrent NSCLC after failure to platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Response Rate (ORR = CR+PR) according to RECIST Criteria

results.dose_information: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m² + Oxaliplatin 120 mg/m² on Day 1 every 21 days

context.duration: Until death, disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, patient refusal, or treatment delay > 3 weeks
